old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a popsicle on a wooden stick, set against a dark background. The popsicle is covered in a creamy, yellowish-white coating that appears to be melting slightly, with small droplets of the same substance dripping down the sides. The coating has a speckled texture, suggesting it might be a flavored ice or a dessert with added toppings. The popsicle itself seems to have a darker, possibly chocolate or caramel base, visible at the bottom where the coating meets the stick. The lighting highlights the glossy surface of the coating, emphasizing its smoothness and the slight sheen from the melting process. The sequence captures the gradual melting effect, including a drip forming and falling from the popsicle.

caption: The video showcases a horizontally held ice-cream bar on a flat wooden stick against a uniform dark background. The cream-colored body, flecked with brown speckles and lit by a glossy highlight on its rounded left tip, stays essentially still, with a chocolate-and-crunch coating marking where the stick enters on the right. Along the lower contour, one of the small wavy bulges slowly swells and elongates downward into a hanging droplet of melted cream. This protrusion stretches into a thin vertical strand with a rounded head, then necks and pinches off, leaving only a faint short line beneath the bar as the drip falls out of view. Afterward the elongated drip is gone and the lower edge again shows a small rounded protrusion at that spot. Meanwhile the leftmost bulge, the rest of the body, the stick, and the chocolate end remain unchanged.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
